verdict.rationale: Sentry's AI agent monitoring covers tracing, conversation replay, LLM call comparison, cost and token dashboards, and tool-call errors. The evidence pack never mentions evaluations, datasets, or custom code-based scorers and metrics. Evals are a fair question for an LLM observability product, so this is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can write custom code-based scorers and metrics for my evaluations
